title: Pixel's Simply Reoptimized
description: Simply Reoptimized - A continuation of Simply Optimized
body:
# Simply Reoptimized
The creator of Simply Optimized has archied their pack, so I decided to see how well I can continue SO with my own twists and changes to it.

> **Current for 1.21.11**  
> I'll eventually work on backporting this pack to earlier versions, starting with notable versions and working my way through it.

## Why SRO?
Simply Reoptimized is made to help make Minecraft playable and not a huge lagfest.  
There are many modpacks out there that optimize the game but they might add some features that might not be needed.

## Are there shader support?
Unlike the original SO modpack, I added Iris Shaders in the pack so you can easily use your favorite shaders.

## Can I play this on servers?
I am mainly focusing on optimization mods, and a couple QOL mods that don't hurt performance and are perfectly usable on multiplayer servers.

## What mod loader is this?
Fabric - Since as far as I'm aware it's the most optimized mod loader.

## Will it actually improve my FPS?
It should! My system is more lower end and I get up to 300FPS at 16 chunks.
